summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Loans & EMIs module. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI renders correctly: portfolio summary card, loan cards with stat pills, analytics panel with all 7 sections, progress bars. Minor: data-testid attributes on React Native TouchableOpacity don't translate to DOM so playwright can't find add-btn by testid (button is visible and functional in browser).

design_issues.screen: Loans Analytics Panel — Interest Saved row
issues: Shows 'via prepayments' sub-label whenever interest_saved > 0 (code: `sub={data.interest_saved > 0 ? 'via prepayments' : 'no prepayments yet'}`). This is misleading — interest_saved can be > 0 even without any prepayment just due to outstanding < original principal. Should show 'via prepayments' only when prepayment_impact.total_prepayments_count > 0.

action_items: Fix 'Interest Saved' sub-label in AnalyticsPanel: show 'via prepayments' only when prepayment_impact.total_prepayments_count > 0, not just when interest_saved > 0.

data-testid on React Native TouchableOpacity does not render as an HTML attribute in web builds; if automated testing is required, use testID prop (React Native convention) or add aria-label for web accessibility.
critical_code_review_comments: loans/index.tsx line 461: `sub={data.interest_saved > 0 ? 'via prepayments' : 'no prepayments yet'}` — incorrect logic, should gate on prepayment_impact.total_prepayments_count > 0.
loans/index.tsx data-testid attributes on TouchableOpacity are not reflected in DOM for React Native Web. Use testID prop instead for reliable automation.
